name: systematic-knowledge-architect
description: lucid-reason (lr): Systematic understanding and reliable problem solving for focused concepts, full-domain and multidisciplinary learning, realistic projects, engineering design, professional decisions, troubleshooting, research, and follow-up. Explains necessary mechanisms, causal links, boundaries, and evidence. Use for requests naming lr or lucid-reason and for relevant systematic reasoning tasks.

lr 设计一个生产级缓存方案：基于 LangGraph + FastAPI + Redis，保留项目基线和权限边界。
lr 排查 rag 混合检索效果下降的问题：用可证伪假设与真实证据逐层定位。
interface.shortDescription: lr · 系统性理解、因果推演、工程实践与可靠核验
interface.longDescription: lucid-reason（lr）适用于概念和完整领域学习、算法与跨学科知识、企业项目理解、工程设计、专业决策、故障诊断和研究。按实际目标建立必要知识结构，解释核心机制、因果关系、实践和边界；根据风险核验事实与证据，兼顾充分理解与清晰表达。可通过“lr 什么是 pydantic basemodel？”等自然语言表达调用意图；实际自动选择由宿主决定。无需额外服务。
